items.html:
Plays for Progressive Cricket Club in NY Metropolitan Cricket League, NY Region. Played for Jamaica in West Indies Cricket Board [WICB] tournaments. Played for USA in WICB Red Stripe Bowl tournament in Jamaica, 1997 and 1998/99 and ICC trophy tournament in Canada in 2001 also played for US team in ICC Six Nations Challenge in UAE 2004. Captain of the USA side in the 2004 Champions Trophy and Intercontinental Cup.
USACA (September 2004)
